analysis.headline: Summary wrongly records an £80 promise on 23 October that the customer explicitly said was not agreed (T16, T17, T22), and omits the risk of further action warning.

claims.explanation: Name, DOB and address verified and security confirmed complete.

evidence.quote: your name, date of birth and address match. Security is complete.

claims.explanation: Agent opened with a general service greeting and the customer explained their query.

evidence.quote: vehicle finance collections. How can I help?
it's about my car finance account

claims.text: arrears and a default notice were discussed,
claims.explanation: Both arrears and the default notice were discussed, with no amounts stated.

evidence.quote: I've had the default notice
There are arrears following missed instalments.

claims.text: and emergency childcare during a three-day school closure caused a shortfall.
claims.explanation: The cause is correct, but the £210 childcare cost is omitted. The Situational Costs rule requires specific financial values for factors affecting ability to pay.

evidence.quote: that cost two hundred and ten pounds
Three days, a heating problem.

claims.text: The customer declined an I&E assessment today,
claims.explanation: The customer explicitly declined the assessment.

evidence.quote: No, I don't want to do an assessment today.

claims.text: and the agent checked understanding that neither the notice nor all arrears were resolved.
claims.explanation: The agent said the payment does not resolve the arrears or cancel the notice, and later said the customer had understood the difference. That check related mainly to the £80 versus £50 distinction, so the reviewer should confirm it.

evidence.quote: this payment doesn't resolve all the arrears or cancel the notice.
You've understood the difference.

claims.explanation: The payment was successful and no amount is stated, as required.

evidence.quote: The fifty-pound payment has been successful.

claims.text: The next steps are to read the notice, prepare income and essential expense figures and call on 23 October after work to review affordability;
claims.explanation: Reading the notice, having figures ready and calling on 23 October are all in the transcript. T25 says Friday, which is 23 October (20 October is a Tuesday).

evidence.quote: call on the twenty-third of October
I'll ring after work.
Please have your income and essential expense figures available

claims.text: the customer agreed to pay £80 on 23 October.
claims.explanation: The customer withdrew the £80 and the agent confirmed it would not be recorded as a promise. No promise to pay was agreed.

evidence.quote: don't write Friday down as agreed
we won't record the eighty as a promise
I haven't promised eighty
How can I help?
Security is complete.

omissions.title: Risk of further action warning not reported
omissions.detail: The agent explicitly warned that the account remains at risk of further action. The rules require the exact phrase.
omissions.suggested_wording: The customer was warned of the risk of further action.

evidence.quote: the account remains at risk of further action

omissions.title: Childcare cost £210 omitted
omissions.detail: The specific cost affecting ability to pay must be included.
omissions.suggested_wording: Emergency childcare costing £210 during a three-day school closure left the customer short.
